theme: Green high meadows and cool mornings - the open, easy summer window before the early-July rush
season: Peak summer (late June 2026) - Srinagar warm by day and cool at dusk, Pahalgam and Sonamarg in the high teens to low twenties, every pass and the Z-Morh tunnel open, the high meadows lush and green and the Dal glass-still at dawn. The Gulmarg gondola is under inspection this week, so the focus is the open meadows, valley drives and the lake. The calm window before the early-July Amarnath rush.
campaign_name: Kashmir Green meadows and cool mornings [INR] - 29 Jun 2026
subject: The meadows are out and the mornings are still cool
